svg.title: Solder mask round a non-plated hole: clear by 0.1 mm, or a ring that gets drilled
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views of a 3.2 mm non-plated mounting hole. Left, right: the mask opening is 0.1 mm larger than the hole all round, so a thin ring of bare board shows and the drill never touches the mask. Right, wrong: the opening is only 0.025 mm larger than the hole; with the drill 0.08 mm off center, the drill cuts into the mask on one side and leaves chipped, flaking mask at the hole's edge.

g.text: ✗ Mask opening a hair bigger than the hole
The drill never reaches the mask
Chips and flakes at the hole's edge
Drawn to scale. A 3.2 mm hole, with the drill 0.08 mm off center on the right.
